title: Trader Diary: BTC at $81,280 (+4%) and my brain on caffeine
content:
📈 8:00 am: “Buy the dip!”
💸 12:00 pm: “Leverage x5, moon!”
🚀 3:00 pm: “Hold, it’s just a pull‑back.”
😅 11:00 pm: “Why is my margin screaming?”
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before the hype hits your DMs.
question: Who else rode the 4% wave with a 5x lever and regretted it at 2 am? Drop your war stories 👇
